definitions.gloss: to accompany, to go together with
definitions.explanation: To go along with someone to the same destination, often in a professional, formal, or supportive capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{同行|どうこう}する。
⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{同行|どうこう}させた。
examples.english: I had my subordinate accompany me on the business trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}{官|かん}→警察官：05056_keisatsukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{同行|どうこう}し、{家宅捜索|かたくそうさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Police officers accompanied the suspect to their home and conducted a house search.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same, together) and {行|こう} (go). More formal than ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧. Often used in business, travel, and official contexts where someone goes along in a professional role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{同行|どうこう}する: to accompany on a business trip
- ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{同行|どうこう}する: to accompany on a news report
- {同行者|どうこうしゃ}: companion, person accompanying
- ⟦{同行|どうこう}→同行：12028_doukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to request someone's company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}き{添|そ}う→付き添う：10585_tsukisou⟧: to attend, to escort — implies providing care or support
- {随行|ずいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to accompany (a superior) — more formal, specifically following a person of higher status
- ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go together — the casual everyday expression
